description: Publish a bus function whose handler runs in a sandbox; no runtime_id needed. source must define handler(payload) in lang; each call runs it and returns its JSON result. The namespace (function_id before `::`) shares one runtime per lang; its functions stop resolving once torn down or idle-reaped.

description.description: What `engine::functions::info` shows a caller — write one.

function_id.description: Bus id, e.g. `my-app::greet`; the segment before the first `::` is the namespace, which holds one persistent runtime per lang.

lang.description: Language of the namespace runtime this handler runs in.

request_format.description: Optional JSON Schema object (≤ 16 KiB, must constrain: `type`/`properties`/`$ref`) for the payload; shown by `engine::functions::info`, not enforced.

response_format.description: Optional JSON Schema for the handler's return value; same rules as `request_format`.

source.description: Source that defines `handler(payload)` in `lang`: `export function handler(payload) {…}` (node) or `def handler(payload): …` (python).

Lang.description:
Which engine backs a runtime.

Only `node` and `python` are accepted; anything else fails deserialization before a handler runs, so the schema itself is the validation.
